summary: Chore Quest backend + frontend tested. 14/14 backend pytest cases PASS (profiles, PIN auth, quests CRUD, completions/duplicate-block, approve/reject, streak milestone bonuses, wheel spin, payouts, leaderboard, stats). Frontend: home loads with Zach/Jacob/Boss cards, PIN modal works, Hero dashboard rendered after fixing missing import (RANK_THRESHOLDS), Quests tab shows daily/weekly/extra with Mark Complete that submits pending completions, Boss Approvals shows pending entries with working Approve/Reject (XP awarded on approve), Boss Quests/Payouts tabs functional. One simple frontend import bug found and fixed by testing agent.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED by testing agent: Missing import of RANK_THRESHOLDS from theme.ts caused 'RANK_THRESHOLDS is not defined' ReferenceError on every kid login (Zach/Jacob), red error overlay blocked the entire hero dashboard.

issues: Bottom-tab labels are 'Quests' and 'Realm' but the test plan / product spec calls them 'Manage Quests' and 'Stats'. Functionality is correct; only label naming differs - confirm desired wording with product owner.

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecation warnings: 'shadow*' and 'textShadow*' style props are deprecated (use boxShadow/textShadow). expo-linear-gradient@55.0.13 vs expected ~15.0.8 and @react-native-async-storage/async-storage@3.0.2 vs expected 2.2.0 may need alignment with installed Expo SDK. Non-blocking but should be cleaned up.

action_items: Optional: rename Boss bottom-tab 'Quests' → 'Manage' and 'Realm' → 'Stats' (or 'Realm Stats') if matching the spec wording is desired.
Optional: align expo-linear-gradient & async-storage versions with Expo SDK expectations to silence warnings.
Optional: replace deprecated shadow*/textShadow* style props with boxShadow/textShadow.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: well-structured, async/await correct, _id consistently excluded, env-driven config. No issues.
Frontend missed importing RANK_THRESHOLDS - simple oversight, fixed by adding to existing import line in dashboard.tsx.

Session uses in-memory state with logout-on-focus on '/' - a hard reload of any /hero/* or /boss/* URL bounces back to profile selector. This is intentional (PIN-gated) but means e2e tests must use in-app navigation, not page.goto.
seed_data_creation: Used existing seeded profiles (Zach/Jacob/Boss) and 15 seeded quests. DB was reset between frontend test runs to ensure deterministic state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite is at /app/backend/tests/test_chore_quest.py (uses pymongo to reset state). Run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_chore_quest.py -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml. Frontend env var is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (NOT EXPO_BACKEND_URL). PIN screen TextInput is hidden but has testID='pin-input' - use page.fill, the 4th digit auto-submits. Hero dashboard requires session (logged-in) - direct goto bounces to '/'. Use bottom-nav tab clicks (`page.locator('text=Quests').last.click()`) instead of page.goto for in-app navigation.
rca_of_issue: RCA: app/hero/dashboard.tsx line 35 used RANK_THRESHOLDS[profile.rank] but the symbol was missing from the import statement on line 8 (only colors/AVATAR_ASSETS/RANK_COLORS imported). Result: ReferenceError thrown at first render of HeroDashboard, error boundary caught it and showed red overlay blocking all kid users from accessing the app. Reproduction: login as Zach (1111) or Jacob (2222) -> 'Uncaught Error: RANK_THRESHOLDS is not defined'. Fix applied: added RANK_THRESHOLDS to the existing named import from '../../src/theme'. Verified: dashboard now renders rank badge, level, XP bar, and streak/gold/spins stat tiles.
